```{r}

library("biomaRt")
library(tidyverse)
library("R.utils")
library("DESeq2")
library(dplyr)
library("pheatmap")
```

```{r}
# make a table with the genes, transcripts, position on the genome, and FPKM
# retain strand information? or TSS and TTS can account for this 

DATAPATH <- '/Users/varshiniramanathan/Documents/HansenLab/blood_data'
# connect to Ensembl
ensembl <- useEnsembl("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# load and prep your count data
counts_df <- data.frame(read_tsv(file.path(DATAPATH, "ct_rna_hbf.tsv")))
values <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", counts_df$gene)  # strip version suffix
rownames(counts_df) <- values
# optional cleanup if these columns exist
counts_df$gene <- NULL
counts_df$...13 <- NULL

# get attributes
ref <- getBM(
  attributes = c(
    "external_gene_name",
    "refseq_mrna",
    "ensembl_gene_id",
    "gene_biotype",
    "chromosome_name",
    "transcript_start",
    "transcript_end",
    "transcript_length",
    "strand"
  ),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = values,
  mart = ensembl
)

# Extract numeric part of refseq_mrna (if present)
ref$txnum <- sapply(strsplit(ref$refseq_mrna, "_"), `[`, 2)

# For each gene, keep the entry with the lowest-numbered RefSeq
tbl <- ref %>%
  group_by(ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  slice_min(as.numeric(txnum), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Deduplicate and tidy
uniqueattributes <- as.data.frame(tbl)
uniqueattributes <- uniqueattributes[!duplicated(uniqueattributes$ensembl_gene_id), ]
uniqueattributes$txnum <- NULL
rownames(uniqueattributes) <- uniqueattributes$ensembl_gene_id
uniqueattributes$ensembl_gene_id <- NULL

```

```{r}
#  remove elements from counts_df that have rownames not in uniqueattributes (not found in ensembl)
counts_df <- counts_df[rownames(counts_df) %in% rownames(uniqueattributes), ] 
counts_df <- counts_df[rownames(uniqueattributes), , drop=FALSE]

# get tpm from this according to michael love snippet:
# x <- counts.mat / gene.length
# tpm.mat <- t( t(x) * 1e6 / colSums(x) )
gene.length <- uniqueattributes[rownames(counts_df), "transcript_length"]

# ensure numeric and in kilobases
gene.length <- as.numeric(gene.length) / 1000  
gene.length[gene.length == 0 | is.na(gene.length)] <- NA
x <- as.matrix(counts_df) / gene.length
tpm_mat <- t(t(x) * 1e6 / colSums(x, na.rm=TRUE)) 
tpm_annotated<-merge(tpm_mat, uniqueattributes, by=0)

```

```{r}

phase_design<-c("P1","P2","P2",
                "P3","P3","P1",
                "P1","P2","P2",
                "P3","P3")

reps<-c(1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2)

samples<-c("D1_P123_Rep1_RNA","D1_P345_Rep1_RNA","D1_P345_Rep2_RNA",
           "D1_P5678_Rep1_RNA","D1_P5678_Rep2_RNA","D2_P123_Rep2_RNA",
           "D3_P123_Rep3_RNA","D3_P345_Rep3_RNA",	"D3_P345_Rep4_RNA",
           "D3_P5678_Rep3_RNA","D3_P5678_Rep4_RNA")
coldata <- data.frame(sample = samples, 
                      phase = phase_design,
                      replicate=reps)
coldata$phase_replicate <- paste0(coldata$phase, "_Rep", coldata$replicate)

rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample
coldata$sample <- NULL

tpm_cols <- colnames(tpm_mat)

tpm_avg <- sapply(unique(coldata$phase), function(pr) {
  cols <- rownames(coldata)[coldata$phase == pr]
  rowMeans(tpm_mat[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
})

tpm_avg_annotated<-merge(tpm_avg,uniqueattributes, by=0)
colnames(tpm_avg_annotated)[colnames(tpm_avg_annotated) == "Row.names"] <- "ensembl_id"

# write to TSV
write.table(
  tpm_avg_annotated,
  file = file.path(DATAPATH, "tpm_avg_annotated.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
